summary: Backend-only tests for new /api/users/sync-status, /api/users/sync (v44), threat-intel auto-sync GET/POST/run-now, and regressions on /api/plugin/signal-log, /api/mailscanner/config, and /api/users listing. 9/9 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~9060 lines — should be split into feature modules for maintainability.

POST /api/users/sync accepts license_key in body but the demo middleware only checks X-Master-Key/query params. Consider allowing body license_key to satisfy the write gate to reduce plugin daemon integration friction (currently daemons must send X-Master-Key header).
In users_sync, _DEMO_USERNAMES deletion is unconditional per call — could add a guard so it only runs once per license to avoid repeated writes on every heartbeat.
seed_data_creation: Created a persistent test user 'testsync1' (domain testsync.com) via POST /api/users/sync as required by the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The new sync-status/sync endpoints and threat-intel auto-sync endpoints are verified. Note: /api/users/sync requires X-Master-Key header (body license_key alone is not enough — the demo middleware blocks writes without header/query). run-now returns {ok, feeds, results:[...]} shape. Auto-sync left disabled as instructed.
rca of the issue: n/a — all endpoints work as specified. Initial test failure was in test code (missing X-Master-Key header on POST /api/users/sync); fixed and all pass.
